subject: matlab-stan: having a problem getting stan version.

messages.author: 188806804221876c
messages.subject: matlab-stan: having a problem getting stan version.
parts:
Hi all,
my cmdstan installation (version 2.5)  works correctly.

I get the following error from matlabStan:

Having a problem getting stan version.
This is likely a problem with Java running out of file descriptors
Trying again. [repeated several times]
Giving up.
Error: File: processManager.m Line: 5 Column: 1
Unexpected MATLAB operator.

Following the FAQ, I did the following links in matlabR2013a/sys/os/glnxa64:

libstdc++.so.6.0.19 -> /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6.0.19
libgcc_s.so.1 -> /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libgcc_s.so.1

but without success. Ideas?

thanks, Giorgio
